ns2:course.label: Design for Manufacturability
ns2:course.description: (M E 285) Introduction to DFM methodologies and tools; quality management (Taguchi, PFD, SPC, etc.); material selection (new and traditional materials); designing for primary manufacturing processes (cutting fundamentals, casting, forming, and shaping); designing with plastics (snap-fits, integral hinges, etc.); design for assembly (DFA); design for inspection and metrology (datums, geometric tolerancing, inspection equipment); computer integrated manufacturing (CIM). Prerequisite: ME 170; credit or concurrent registration in ME 330.
